FAQ

Can’t find what you need? Talk to us.

About Trnzit

What is Trnzit?

Trnzit is a treasury management platform from the Trnznd Group. It gives you one login and one view across your bank accounts, credit cards, crypto exchanges, custodians and digital wallets, with approval policies that control what can happen in them.

Is Trnzit a bank, exchange, wallet or custodian?

No. Trnzit is a technology platform only. It isn’t a bank, a wallet provider, a custodian, an exchange or an investment platform. Your assets stay with the providers you already use, and those providers carry out every transaction on your instructions.

Does Trnzit give investment advice or manage assets?

No. Trnzit doesn’t advise on, recommend or manage investments. It simplifies and centralises control of the accounts you already hold.

Who is Trnzit for?

Mainly institutional and corporate treasury teams, finance directors and family offices. It’s also useful for experienced individuals with many accounts across exchanges, wallets and banks.

Custody & security

Does Trnzit ever hold my private keys or assets?

No. Trnzit and the Trnznd Group never hold private keys, seed phrases or client assets, and never take custody. You keep control and custody at all times.

If Trnzit doesn’t hold private keys, how do transactions happen?

You (and, for organisations, your approvers) approve an instruction in Trnzit. Trnzit passes it through a secure API to the provider you selected, and that provider executes it. For multi-signature wallets, the signing keys are held by your own members, never by Trnzit.

How does Trnzit stop one person moving funds alone?

Business accounts can set M-of-N approval policies, authority levels and whitelisted addresses, so material actions need more than one person. Initiators can’t approve their own requests, and policy changes need approval too. Individual account holders keep sole control of their own accounts.

Will Trnzit ever ask for my seed phrase?

Never. Not by email, phone, chat or in the app. If someone asks, it isn’t us. Please report it to [security contact email].

What certifications or audits does Trnzit have?

We’ll publish independently verified security information on our Security & Governance page as it becomes available. We don’t list certifications, audits or licences that aren’t in place. [Update when confirmed]

Connections

What can I connect?

Bank accounts, credit cards, crypto exchanges, custodians and digital wallets. Bank and card connections are read-only. Which connections you can use depends on your plan: Basic supports crypto connections only. See supported providers.

Which multi-signature wallets are supported?

Safe (formerly Gnosis Safe) for EVM-compatible assets, and Squads for Solana-based assets. In both, the signing keys are held by your own members, never by Trnzit.

Can I open new accounts through Trnzit?

Trnzit lists exchanges and on- and off-ramp providers you can open accounts with. You open each account directly with the provider, under its own terms and checks, and then connect it to Trnzit. See supported providers.

What does Trnzit store to connect my accounts?

Trnzit stores the API details you provide to connect each account, with the narrowest access each provider allows. It never stores private keys or seed phrases. You can revoke a connection at any time. [Draft, to be confirmed by our technical team: API details are encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256), with keys held in a separate key management service.] See Security & Governance.

Can Trnzit move money from my bank account?

No. Bank account and credit card connections are read-only. Trnzit can show balances and transactions, but it can’t initiate payments from them.

Can I disconnect a provider?

Yes, at any time, from Trnzit or by withdrawing access directly at the provider.

Pricing & billing

How much does Trnzit cost?

Normal prices are $29, $99 and $249 a month for Basic, Premium and Institution, or $290, $990 and $2,490 a year. New users pay about half for their first 12 months: Basic $14.99 a month or $149.90 a year, Premium $49.99 or $499.90, and Institution $124.99 or $1,249.90. Annual billing gives you two months free. See Pricing for what each plan includes.

How can I pay?

Prices are in US dollars. You can pay in USD by Visa, Mastercard, Google Pay, Apple Pay or PayPal, or in USDT or USDC. [Confirm accepted USDT/USDC networks]

Is there a free trial?

If you pay by card, Google Pay, Apple Pay or PayPal, you get a 30-day free trial, which you can cancel at any time within the 30 days. A pre-authorisation hold of $15 is placed before the trial starts.

If you pay in USDT or USDC, there’s no standard free trial. Instead, you get a 30-day trial limited to one exchange or wallet connection.

Why is there a pre-authorisation hold?

The hold confirms that your payment method is valid before the trial starts. [Confirm the purpose of the hold, and when and how it is released]

How do I cancel?

During a free trial, you can cancel at any time within the 30 days. After the trial, cancel with at least 30 days’ notice; the service ends on your renewal date. [Confirm how notice is given]

Getting started

My company doesn’t use digital assets yet. Can Trnzit help?

Yes. Contact our support team for information on getting started: [support email], or use the contact page.

How long does set-up take?

Minutes. As soon as your payment is confirmed (or, for a free trial, your $15 pre-authorisation), you can start connecting your providers and inviting your team members.

Can I change plan later?

Yes. You can upgrade at any time, and your new plan and contract start immediately. If you upgrade part way through an annual plan, a new 12-month plan starts at the higher price, and the unused part of your current plan is credited against it. Monthly plans work the same way: the new plan starts immediately at the higher fee, the unused part of your current month is credited against your first new monthly fee, and every month after that is charged on the new plan.

Downgrades take effect at your next renewal date.
